parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The IDs of the resources. You can specify up to 50 IDs in each request.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to **DOMAIN**.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags. You can specify up to 20 tags in each request.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the tag. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the tag. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**.
